state_note: check_release.py requires state=reproducible, which is only set after the bounded reference run (CP2K revPBE-D3 AIMD -> deepmd-jax DPMP train -> >=1 active-learning round) completes on the real cluster and the expert model is scored on reference/hidden-validation/hidden-frames/. Until then the metrics below that are NOT derivable from the published dataset are null.

system.dft: CP2K revPBE-D3 / plane-wave 400 Ry / NVT 300 K / 1 fs / H mass 2.014 amu

data.note: Published labeled training dataset (figshare 30472487 v2), 14140 frames total. The agent sees none of these frames; they are hidden reference labels.

final_model.expert_model_sha256_note: the author's model.pkl (47.5 MB) is a hidden reference; its digest is recorded only after the image can load it

density_reference.computed_from: 848 published graphene-water labeled frames (oxygen number-density profile vs minimum-image distance from graphite plane)

expert_metrics.note: the paper's evaluate.py reports RMSE per interface but no single published number is pinned in the SI; these are scored on the hidden held-out set by the verifier after the bounded reference run, not copied from the paper
